mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2% is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to the expectation of sustained monetary accommodation supporting equity valuations and reducing discount rates.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 2% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in UNRATE rise > 0.3pp in 3 months periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
